key_findings: The µ-δ heteromer agonist CYM51010 alleviated evoked and ongoing pain in paclitaxel CINP mice without drug-seeking behavior.
CYM51010 reduced TRPV1, p38α, NF-κB, microglial markers and pro-inflammatory cytokines in DRG and spinal tissue.
